review.tagline: Next.js SaaS template with Stripe billing, email/password auth and team dashboard
review.summary: A minimal Next.js starter with a landing page, a pricing page wired to Stripe Checkout, and a dashboard with user and team CRUD. Auth is email/password with JWTs in cookies, roles are Owner and Member, and data lives in Postgres through Drizzle. The README describes it as a learning resource and points to paid templates for fuller feature sets.
review.audience: Developers who want a minimal Next.js SaaS base with Stripe and Postgres
strengths: Stripe Checkout, Customer Portal and webhook handling already wired up
Small stack: Next.js, Postgres, Drizzle, shadcn/ui, with migration and seed scripts
Activity logging and Zod-validated Server Action middleware included
MIT licensed, with a live demo on Vercel
weaknesses: No AI features included despite the list's AI focus
Only email/password auth; no OAuth or social login mentioned
Only two roles (Owner, Member); RBAC is basic
Requires Stripe CLI and a Stripe account even for local setup
needs: Needs Postgres, Stripe, Stripe CLI, pnpm
